title: I finish what I start 😍
body: I was skeptical at first to believe how this app could help me focus better and stay on task until finished. Now, I can’t live without it ❤️Thank you for making my life easier!!! I am WOWed how much more I accomplish with using Unique. I love the 3 Minute Rule. Thank you also for your genuine care, incredible customer service and making me feel heard. I bragged about it to my friends, now 3 of them are using it and can’t believe how much sharper, less overwhelmed and happier they are. I love how the app celebrates the small wins, they help me stay motivated ❤️❤️❤️

title: A Disappointment
body: A lot of apps today are intentionally designed to trick people into paying for subscriptions. They push free trials that automatically convert, hide the real cost in tiny text, rush users through the screen, and don’t give a fair chance to review the purchase before charging. That’s not innovation—it’s manipulation. When people feel forced or misled into paying, that’s a scam, plain and simple.

author: bekistar70

title: Not enough time to know if I like it or not
body:
This app seems different than others. It doesn’t “seem” like they are out for money and are trying to feed you a bunch of garbage. It really seems genuine. However, I am rating it 1 little star all because, like so many other apps, it only gives you 7 measly days to try the app out before you get charged for the month or the year. I mean come on! I have ADD, don’t really think I’ve used the app enough in 7 days to actually figure out it’s worthy to pay for it, or subscribe to it, or not? Heck 30 days probably isn’t enough time either but I could understand that better. 

So, like many other apps, I will delete it and cancel it today (before the 7 days are up) and will never know if it would’ve helped me or not. Which is too bad because like I said I feel like this app is different, in a good way. Oh well.
